subject: Concept art of one impact crater on the surface of an airless rocky moon, for a sci-fi strategy game's colony scene: a round, bowl-shaped crater about 30 meters across with a raised, rough rim of broken regolith and boulders, terraced inner slopes, a flat floor with a few small rocks, and a scatter of ejecta around the rim fading out into a round patch of flat, even ground whose edge is plain and level. Cool light-gray regolith (#97999F to #686A79) with darker shadows; no buildings, no vehicles, no plants. Seen in a three-quarter view from above (the camera about 35 degrees above the ground), the whole crater and its patch of ground centered with a wide empty margin, nothing cut off, on a plain near-black background. Even, clear light so the shape reads. No text or lettering anywhere.
style: Clean and neat: one object, whole and readable, on a plain background. Palette: background and dark surfaces in deep navy blacks (#0A0F16, #111722, #192130) and slate blues (#242D41, #3E4D6B); light in electric blue to pale cyan (#4E87BB, #71B2D8, #ACDBE9), the only bright accent; hulls and structures in cool steel grays (#686A79, #97999F). Crisp and sharp everywhere: clean hard edges, fine detail; no haze, no soft focus, no depth-of-field or motion blur. Realistic light, cinematic concept art. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no interface, no lens flares.
